title: Robot Vacuum Cleaner
statementMd:
Pushok the dog has been chasing Imp for a few hours already.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8349588abe648162884b78b5b42f99880b695f4e.png)

Fortunately, Imp knows that Pushok is afraid of a robot vacuum cleaner.

While moving, the robot generates a string $*t*$ consisting of letters '`s`' and '`h`', that produces a lot of noise. We define *noise* of string $*t*$ as the number of occurrences of string "`sh`" as a **subsequence** in it, in other words, the number of such pairs $(*i*, *j*)$, that $*i* < *j*$ and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa3acb2a51fec405fff3ffa731bf524c21b71047.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/84e6f388d5468490ab0877195de0181911c46019.png).

The robot is off at the moment. Imp knows that it has a sequence of strings $*t*_{*i*}$ in its memory, and he can arbitrary change their order. When the robot is started, it generates the string $*t*$ as a concatenation of these strings in the given order. The noise of the resulting string equals the noise of this concatenation.

Help Imp to find the maximum noise he can achieve by changing the order of the strings.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of strings in robot's memory.

Next $*n*$ lines contain the strings $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$, one per line. It is guaranteed that the strings are non-empty, contain only English letters '`s`' and '`h`' and their total length does not exceed $10^{5}$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maxumum possible *noise* Imp can achieve by changing the order of the strings.

## Note

The optimal concatenation in the first sample is $*ssshhshhhs*$.
statementZhMd:
Pushok 这只狗已经追逐 Imp 几个小时了。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8349588abe648162884b78b5b42f99880b695f4e.png)

幸运的是，Imp 知道 Pushok 害怕机器人吸尘器。

机器人移动时，会生成一个由字母 '`s`' 和 '`h`' 组成的字符串 $*t*$，并发出大量噪音。我们将字符串 $*t*$ 的**噪音**定义为其中字符串 "`sh`" 作为**子序列**出现的次数，换句话说，就是满足以下条件的数对 $(*i*, *j*)$ 的数量：$*i* < *j*$，并且

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa3acb2a51fec405fff3ffa731bf524c21b71047.png)

以及

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/84e6f388d5468490ab0877195de0181911c46019.png)。

目前机器人处于关闭状态。Imp 知道它的内存中存储着一组字符串 $*t*_{*i*}$，并且可以任意改变这些字符串的顺序。机器人启动后，会按照给定的顺序将这些字符串连接起来，生成字符串 $*t*$。所得字符串的噪音就是这个连接字符串的噪音。

请帮助 Imp 通过改变字符串的顺序，求出他能够达到的最大噪音。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——机器人内存中的字符串数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含字符串 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*n*}$，每行一个。保证这些字符串非空，仅包含英文字母 '`s`' 和 '`h`'，且它们的总长度不超过 $10^{5}$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Imp 通过改变字符串顺序所能达到的最大噪音。

## 说明

第一个样例中的最优连接结果为 $*ssshhshhhs*$。
